title: Corrigir decodificação de PazuCore.GameExtraSettings
summary: PazuCore.GameExtraSettings: confirmed as the same TypeTreeGeneratorAPI SerializableDictionaryBase<K,V> limitation as the 27 classes closed earlier this session, reached indirectly via the named subclass `Name_Back_Scene / Name_Audio / Name_AudioEvent` on field `nameBackScene (also backgroundMusics, audioEvents - same mechanism, not individually isolated which one trips the crash first)`. Initially left open because a literal string grep missed the indirect reference; resolved by checking field types against the full subclass list instead of the raw generic string.
